Awaaz saaf ho to log video zyada der dekhte hain.
👉 Shant kamre mein record karo
👉 Mic ya phone mooh se 1 haath door rakho
👉 Parde, takiye ya bed ke paas baitho (echo kam hoga)
👉 Pehle 10 second ka test karo, phir poora video

Aapko awaaz ki sabse badi problem kya lagti hai? Comment mein batao 👇
